node.title: Re^5: How can I test for the representation of an integer?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [sm@sh],

"1"==1, "1" eq 1, and looks_like_number(1) and looks_like_number("1") are all true in Perl. The [http://stackoverflow.com/questions/12686335/how-to-tell-apart-numeric-scalars-and-string-scalars-in-perl|StackOverflow thread] that [clueless newbie] [id://1161438|linked to] already contains some excellent answers - especially [choroba] and [ikegami]'s answers explain the caveats of peeking under the hood. That's why I recommended looking for a different solution to your problem than figuring out difference between 1 and "1".

Regards,
-- Hauke D
